symptom: A published OData service that exposes a Binary attribute (the entity's own, or one it inherits) passed `check` and `exec`; `mx check` reported CE5013 "Binary attribute 'Photo' cannot be exposed through an OData entity."
file: mdl/executor/validate_published_binary.go ValidatePublishedBinary (MDL110), wired in validate_program.go. Tests validate_published_binary_test.go; fixtures mdl-examples/bug-tests/published-odata-binary-attribute.fail.mdl and published-odata-attribute-types.mdl
cause: The writer maps Binary to Edm.Binary to keep the mapping total and its comment already said Mendix rejects it, but nothing refused the member before the write.
insight: **Of eleven OData codes in the coverage list, re-measuring found three still reachable from MDL; this is the publish-side one.** CE0309 (key marked CanBeEmpty), CE0729 (empty service name) and CE4583 (exposed enumeration) build clean now because the writer handles them; every other attribute type was measured as exposing clean, so the rule is Binary only. The attribute is resolved through the generalization chain, because an inherited Binary attribute fails the same way and is the case a by-entity lookup would miss.
